resampling.unit: country cluster within domain; repeated fold errors for sampled country stay paired
resampling.estimand: equal mean across the four outer-fold MAEs; paired model-minus-comparator
resampling.draws: A shared country-cluster draw matrix is used for all pairwise comparisons within each domain.
resampling.comparisons: Every method vs Persistence; TimesFM2_5_ILSA_LoRA additionally vs matched TimesFM2_5_zero_shot.

limitations: Conditional on four observed historical target cycles; does not quantify between-cycle uncertainty.
Conditions on published point estimates; does not propagate plausible-value, complex-survey, or scale-link uncertainty.
Participating countries are a selected set, not a probability sample of all education systems.
Intervals are exploratory and not confirmatory significance tests or evidence of prospective performance.
overwrite_policy: Output directory must not exist before execution.
